## [1.1.0](https://github.com/henr1klmb/henr1k-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0) (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* **netmirror:** add ad blocker, tracker blocker and custom icon patches ([efca552](https://github.com/henr1klmb/henr1k-patches/commit/efca552b1ba303aa44474c11e876ec2ef28f6e28))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **build:** revert gradle wrapper to 9.8.2 and update README ([8ade59c](https://github.com/henr1klmb/henr1k-patches/commit/8ade59caea7758c2ad3d6c2618f3d25a0366eed8))

patches.name: Custom icon
patches.description: Changes the app name and optionally replaces the launcher icons of NetMirror.

options.description: Custom name displayed on the home screen.
Absolute path to a square PNG file to replace all launcher icons.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Blocks popup windows and ad elements in NetMirror.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes analytics, tracking hooks, and device fingerprinting in NetMirror.

patches.name: AMOLED dark mode
patches.description: Replaces dark background colors in night mode with pure black (#FF000000).

patches.name: Disable Adjust tracking
patches.description: Prevents the Adjust analytics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.

patches.name: Disable Instana tracking
patches.description: Prevents the Instana monitoring and telemetry SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.

patches.name: Disable Optimizely A/B testing
patches.description: Prevents the Optimizely SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.

patches.name: Disable Qualtrics tracking
patches.description: Prevents the Qualtrics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.

patches.name: Disable Tealium tracking
patches.description: Prevents the Tealium analytics SDK from initializing in DB Navigator.

patches.name: Enable screenshots
patches.description: Removes the FLAG_SECURE window flag in DB Navigator to allow taking screenshots and screen recordings.
